record.hypothesis: A 150-packet AVC stream was encoded once in MP4 and stream-copied to Matroska. Every packet has the same payload size and SHA-256 in both containers. The first packet hash is SHA256:de4472b3c0e949b4f79e3a6a66dfbd8e925e97ea2d63e033a1287505875f6201. That supports making a prepared/cache object container-independent at the coded-sample layer when decoder configuration, dependency boundaries, color/output semantics and authorization also match. It does not imply the surrounding MP4/MKV bytes, timestamps, cue structures, or decoder configuration records are interchangeable.
